response.rationale: Both answers correctly express “stingy” in the stated sense. “Pelit” is an appropriate Indonesian form and “kedekut” an appropriate Malaysian Malay form. The different-common-word relation is valid, though not exclusive; “kikir,” “lokek,” and “bakhil” may also occur. No false-friend contrast is asserted or needed to prevent misunderstanding.
